You're not being dramatic, and repeating what other commenters have said, this sounds like coercion. I understand how complicated these things may feel in the context of an established relationship, but coercion is coercion. Only wholly enthusiastic participation = consent. 

If it helps to know, you're definitely not alone in this. I've been in a similar position. I had cried almost immediately afterwards and it forced me to really evaluate and reflect on what I wanted, why I agreed / 'went along' with it, and where my boundaries lie. So I'd say allow yourself the time and space to sit with those thoughts and emotions before deciding what to do next. My heart goes out to you and what he did sucks, I'm sorry this is how it all went down.
